methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNFPA's publications catalog is a Drupal-based, fully server-rendered listing (~694 results). Cards, cover images, descriptions, language variants, pagination and direct PDF links are all embedded in the initial HTML, making it one of the more scrapable UN catalogs.

## Search
The listing supports a full-text query parameter (?search={query}). Browse via pagination.

## Filters
Facets appear as URL parameters on the listing; treated as opaque params (no formal schema).

## Download
Strong download story: each card exposes a direct PDF under /sites/default/files/pub-pdf/{file}.pdf (e.g. unfpa-ar2025-EN-v260608.pdf). PDFs can frequently be captured directly from the listing without visiting the record page, though record pages at /publications/{slug} also carry them and any multi-language variants.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, publication date, short description and available languages are in server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API; enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
No public API. Pagination uses ?page=N (~57 pages at ~12/page). Behind a CDN; send a realistic User-Agent. Some publications have multiple language PDFs; pick the desired language variant.
